explanation: The router exposes routePending (true for the boot route until its mount effect delivers it, and while a named track is being checked), and App holds its explorer-on-screen active-track load until it clears and while a refusal is on screen (routeError). The explorer still starts on the default dataset and a link moves it, but the default track is no longer loaded before the link lands, so a cold link to another study or another macaque track no longer fetches the macaque default track (409 KB compressed, plus its 192 KB pathway sibling), and a link refused after its check loads nothing behind the error page. The 2.2 KB macaque metadata still loads, as on every view.
